description: This PHP source file defines the 'SugarTab' class, which handles the setup, rendering, and display of tabbed navigation components in the SuiteCRM interface. It manages user preferences for tab visibility, constructs tab menus including 'more' options, and utilizes the Smarty templating engine to generate the output.

classes.name: SugarTab
classes.description: Represents a UI tab component that manages tab setup, rendering, and display using Smarty templates in the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SugarTab object with a specified type and creates a new Smarty instance.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the tab display, including visible and hidden tabs based on user preferences and version configuration, and prepares data for rendering.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Returns the rendered HTML of the tab component using Smarty templates.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the rendered HTML of the tab component directly.
